objective: Characterize the reachable oddness-state manifold inside each fixed descriptor-presence fiber of ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE, and determine how much of its affine constraint structure is explained by exact component-width conservation.

frozenCoordinate.presenceFiber: fixed set of descriptors with n_d>0
frozenCoordinate.oddnessVector: O_d=n_d mod 2 over the descriptors present in that fiber

measurements: GF(2) affine dimension of each fiber
affine codimension and all linear parity checks on the fiber
whether the exact width-parity check is present
whether width parity is the only independent linear constraint
number of additional independent linear constraints beyond width parity
whether the observed fiber is a complete affine subspace of its affine hull
ZOE base-load slack (W-B)/2 histogram and number of signatures with zero slack
antiCircularity: This experiment uses structural class keys only; scalar W/D/L outputs are not used by any fiber-geometry calculation.
Width and descriptor widths are frozen structural facts.
No parity check is selected from outcome labels.
falsifiers: Any observed structural signature violating exact integer width budget or width parity invalidates the harness.
If every nontrivial affine constraint is generated by width parity, the linear manifold model is supported on that fiber.
Additional affine constraints must be frozen explicitly rather than attributed to width conservation.
Non-affine fiber incompleteness is preserved as a separate structural fact.
nextIfWidthOnly: Quotient OOO algebra by the exact width-parity ideal and remeasure the scalar remainder before searching for additional structural laws.
nextIfAdditionalLinear: Render the recurring additional parity checks in IsoGraph and identify their primitive residual/phase meaning.
nextIfNonlinear: Treat the reachable oddness set as a constrained non-linear ZOE partition manifold and derive its minimum support constraints before formula selection.
interpretationGuards: Affine dimension is a property of the observed structural carrier, not a W/D/L claim.
A fixed-width parity relation is necessary but need not be sufficient for realizability.
No Q-A/Q-F or standard-7x6 claim follows.
